LESSON: READING 4.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension, part of Strand 4 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why are pictures important? 2. How can you use pictures to communicate ?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. view pictures, illustrations, posters, videos, pictures maps mnemonics, and symbols among others collaboratively with peers,

2. describe and interpret visuals correctly with peers,

3. preview and make predictions based on pictures and illustrations related to the theme,

4. infer the meaning of the words related to the theme,

5. compose songs, stories, poems or dialogues on road safety and prevention featuring words,

6. answer questions based on the visuals with peers,

7. present own stories using pictures or videos,

8. create visuals based on their experiences. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. view pictures, illustrations, posters, videos, pictures maps mnemonics, and symbols among others collaboratively with peers,
2. describe and interpret visuals correctly with peers,
3. preview and make predictions based on pictures and illustrations related to the theme,
4. infer the meaning of the words related to the theme,
5. compose songs, stories, poems or dialogues on road safety and prevention featuring words,
6. answer questions based on the visuals with peers,
7. present own stories using pictures or videos,
8. create visuals based on their experiences. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-Efficacy is developed as the learner reads and interprets visuals.

• Digital Literacy is achieved as the learner looks for or watches visuals in digital format.

Values:
Responsibility is enhanced as the learner composes poems and answers questions related to the theme collaboratively

with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life Skills Education: Effective communication is enhanced as the learner learns how to read and interpret visuals and

can therefore communicate effectively using visuals.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner applies the concept of interpreting visuals to similar concepts learnt in Art and craft. This is also applicable

when interpreting maps and charts, a concept taught in Social Studies.
